title: Unify gate field naming across JSON outputs
description:
Single-issue JSON emits gates with a `key` field while the per-issue gate status command emits `gate_statuses` entries with `gate_key`; agents wrote fallback lookups guessing both names, and one projection printed a null gate name when the guess missed.

## Background

Decided convention: `key` and `status` are canonical, matching the issue record's `gates[].key` — the larger existing surface. The per-issue gate status command migrates `gate_key` to `key` and its collection key `gate_statuses` to `gates`.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Everywhere gates appear in JSON output, the gate is identified by `key` and its state by `status`; gate collections use the key `gates`.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: The unified shape is documented; the renamed fields are called out in a migration note.
